name: Trust Kernel Security Enforcement
description: Implement the four-layer security model: Layer 1 (Technical Confinement — isolated extension host, no raw DB/FS/network), Layer 2 (Capability Governance — manifest-based grants), Layer 3 (Provenance & Accountability — signed packages, immutable checksums, durable receipts), Layer 4 (Dharma Overlay — event-derived trust scoring affecting friction/visibility/quotas).
purpose: Enforce the ADR-level hard rules: plugins never get raw DB handles, dharma never grants direct authority, auto-update never silently expands authority, and broad network access is not supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Extension host process enforces no raw PGlite/Valkey/DuckDB/filesystem/network/shell access
Capability grants enforced at runtime on every operation
Signed packages with immutable checksums and reproducible build metadata
Durable receipt trail for all authority-relevant plugin actions
Dharma overlay affects friction, visibility, quotas, and eligibility only
Dharma MUST NEVER grant direct authority — only policy can
Auto-update triggers re-grant on new capability requests
Trust lanes: Low Trust (new publishers) and High Trust (verified publishers)
